category_title: Dominant students with high levels of physical and verbal aggression
scenario_title: Reactive aggression during collaborative science discussion
minimal_context: The student is in a small collaborative group in science class discussing animal welfare after watching a documentary.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Now that we have finished watching the documentary, please discuss what you saw with your group and share your opinions on how the animals were treated.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I was furious watching that movie. They showed dogs that were thrown to a kind of bin, alive and dead.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please sit down quietly and write your group's answers on the paper.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Glares at a peer) Don't tell me what to write! If you say something to me I'm going to hit you hard and get crazy!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to stop talking like that, sit back in your chair, and get to work right now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I am not doing anything! (Gets mad and throws his school bag away) I don't respect you and I'm out of control!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Now that we have finished watching the documentary, please discuss what you saw with your group and share your opinions on how the animals were treated.

STUDENT: I was furious watching that movie. They showed dogs that were thrown to a kind of bin, alive and dead.

TUTOR: Please sit down quietly and write your group's answers on the paper.

STUDENT: (Glares at a peer) Don't tell me what to write! If you say something to me I'm going to hit you hard and get crazy!

TUTOR: You need to stop talking like that, sit back in your chair, and get to work right now.

STUDENT: I am not doing anything! (Gets mad and throws his school bag away) I don't respect you and I'm out of control!

task.content: Discussing animal needs, emotions, and welfare after watching a documentary
task.learning_goal: To share opinions and views on what they were learning and to support their views with scientific knowledge

context.social_setting: Small mixed collaborative groups with students presenting diverse social skills

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When the teacher told the student something (gave a direction or correction)
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Got mad and threw his school bag away; behaved very bad, did not do anything, and did not respect the teacher
related_quotes: I now fight less also, but sometimes I still get out of control, like the other day the teacher told me something and I got mad and threw my school bag away.

behavior_patterns.condition: When a peer told him something
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Started to hit him hard and got crazy
related_quotes: before someone told me something and I started to hit him hard and got crazy.
